mapper.select: SELECT psb.id AS bind_id, psb.student_id, psb.relation, s.name AS student_name, s.student_number, c.name AS class_name FROM parent_student_bind psb LEFT JOIN student s ON psb.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN class_info c ON s.class_id = c.id WHERE psb.parent_id = #{parentId} AND psb.deleted = 0 AND s.deleted = 0 ORDER BY psb.create_time ASC
SELECT * FROM parent_student_bind WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM parent_student_bind WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND student_id = #{studentId} AND deleted = 0
